answer_1.quote: Text Style Transfer aims to alter the style of input text x to produce output text y while preserving the original content.
datasets: Genshin (Xiangling, Hutao, Mona, Diluc, Venti, Noelle)

answer_2.quote: We use automatic metrics to assess attribute control, such as style accuracy (ACC) and content preservation (CP) after transfer. For content preservation, we calculate Self-BLEU using SacreBLEU, and we also report the geometric mean (G-score) of ACC and CP.

answer_4.quote: We conducted human evaluations by sampling 50 instances from each dataset. The baselines used for comparison are: ... Five participants were enlisted to assess each model based on three criteria: (1) strength of style transfer, (2) semantic integrity, and (3) sentence fluidity.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each generated sentence on three questions: style transfer strength, semantic integrity, and fluency.
